sentences.text:
Palash Mondal vs Unknown on 19 May, 2023
19.05.2023.
32. Ct.No.28 as (Rejected) C.R.M. (Db) 2041 of 2023 In Re:- An application for bail under Section
439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Berhampore P. S. Case No.52 of 2022
dated 08.01.2022 under Sections 498A/325/307 of the Indian Penal Code and charge sheet
submitted under Sections 498A/302/304B of the Indian Penal Code.
In the matter of : Palash Mondal.
Mr. Arnab Chatterjee, Ms. Poulami Bose.
Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji, ld. P.P., Ms. Faria Hossain, Mr. Anand Keshari.
Heard the learned Advocates for the parties.
We have considered the materials on record.
Dying declaration of the victim implicates the petitioner in the murder.
Under such circumstances and in view of gravity of offence, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is rejected.

(Ajay Kumar Gupta,J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
